dispute_adjudication.resolution: NICE2026 anti-D: no routine prophylaxis up to11+6, offerRhD-negative medical/surgical12+0–12+6 within its early-pregnancy scope. Draft defers gestation/method/local guidance. Older NHS/RCOG universal surgical statements not propagated. NHS/RCOG and QLDTable17 at least3months afterMTX contrasted with QLDp5 fourmonths; draft explicitly attributes patient advice and requires individual clearance. Scar SMFM2022 against expectant/systemicMTXalone governs specialist caveat over older2016 broad options. Assessing breastfeeding does not impose an unqualified lifelong cessation rule.
